technical.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) novelty：确认与回执沿用常见管理模式取小幅；mechanism：候选、范围和 Host 门控有具体组合取实质；transferability：[Q03](#research-q03) 可借鉴但绑定精确版本取实质以下上限；simplification：减少手动接线但不省审查取实质以下。

business.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) workflow：搜索到使用连续化取实质；delivery：[Q02](#research-q02) 范围和回执明确取实质；reach：[Q03](#research-q03) 依赖受支持 DSH 与服务取小幅；economics：[Q04](#research-q04) 缺费用和耗时对照，未知。

recommendation.reason: 需要在 DSH 中管理 SkillHub 技能的用户，可在测试 profile 选择明确候选并核验范围。相比手工复制，它连接搜索、确认和操作回执，但仍需审阅技能内容。若版本不兼容、来源歧义或状态无法确认，应停止写入并回退手工审核。

scenario.rationale: [Q01](#research-q01) 用户、发现与安装任务及手工基线明确达一半；频率和需求强度未有独立材料不足更高档。

advantage.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) 确认范围与回执提供超越入口的接线，高于局部便利；真实效果和技能风险未知不足更高档。

evidence.rationale: [Q02](#research-q02) [Q03](#research-q03) 工具声明、确认及兼容门有固定源码，超过单一声明；未运行 Host 和服务不足本地测试档。

cost.rationale: [Q04](#research-q04) 精确版本、来源和外部技能审查均需维护，有重要未知；可停止并手工审核高于零档，恢复未测不足一半。

      "content": "# SkillHub for DeepSeek Harness

[English](README.en.md)

SkillHub 的 DSH 原生插件。在 DSH 侧栏打开 **技能中心**，匿名浏览、搜索、查看技能详情，并管理安装、升级和卸载；对话中也可搜索和明确请求安装技能。插件内置本地安装核心，无需另装 SkillHub CLI。

`0.2.0` 新增来源可核验的搜索安装状态：广场卡片和对话工具可识别当前来源的受管理安装版本、用户/项目范围及异常记录；对话保留查询时快照。未发现本来源记录不代表其他市场或手工安装不存在，文件存在也不代表 DSH 已启用该技能。按来源、命名空间和技能标识匹配；不按同名目录认领其他来源技能。

`0.2.1` 缺省连接 `https://skill.xfyun.cn`；显式空串或仅空白仍表示断开，已有自定义地址保留。插件不继承 CLI 的默认地址或凭证。

`0.4.0` 使用独立标签 `dsh-v0.4.0`，提供技能案例与原生输入框衔接、对话管理已安装技能及按安装位置独立维护版本。保留 `0.3.1` 的双 RC 兼容范围。公开可用状态以 npm 为准；本地构建的 tarball 可按下文独立验证。

`0.5.0` 新增技能卡片及对话中的只读可用性诊断，分别报告文件完整性、宿主发现和调用策略，保留 `0.4.0` 的兼容范围及库存格式。

`0.6.1` 包含受管理技能启停、统一只读检查更新，以及横向已安装卡片和更多菜单。共享库存继续使用 v2，不要求用户同步升级 CLI；已通过与 CLI 0.2.0 的真实旧包兼容验收。公开可用状态以 npm 为准。

## 使用已安装技能

市场、已安装列表和对话中的日常列表均按技能展示。点击“使用技能”，由 Host 核验当前会话实际可用的唯一安装；不会让用户猜安装位置。技能中心入口在同一工作区新建对话，对话内入口保留当前会话。案例显示在原生输入框上方，确认案例或自定义任务后填入可编辑草稿；不会自动发送、调用模型或覆盖原会话草稿。

已安装卡片的更多菜单中，“管理安装”进入技能详情，右侧直接展示每个位置的版本和状态，可明确使用此位置、检查更新、启停或卸载。全停用或状态无法确认时先进入管理安装。安装范围放在安装确认的高级选项中，未安装技能仍默认安装到当前用户。

需要当前活动会话。被项目同名技能覆盖、本地文件变更、禁止用户调用或会话/来源变化时会提示原因；历史回执不能代替当前安装状态。此功能自 `0.4.0` 起提供。

## 构建与打包

在仓库根目录执行：

```sh
cd cli
bun install --frozen-lockfile
cd ../plugins/dsh
bun install --frozen-lockfile
bun run check
npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts
```

`dsh-typert-generator` 固定在 `0.2.0-rc.2` 以生成两个宿主共用的 RPC 契约；其他 DSH 开发依赖按 `0.2.1-rc.2` 类型检查。生成器版本不是宿主版本绕过条件。

`check` 依次构建 Host、Client、Remote 绑定与类型声明，执行 typecheck、lint 和测试。插件 lint 使用 `cli/` 中锁定的工具。Bun 仅用于开发构建，包内 Host 在 Node 上运行；React/React DOM 由 DSH 提供。

检查通过后，将候选包保存到仓库外的独立目录：

```sh
npm pack --ignore-scripts --pack-destination /absolute/path/to/candidate-output
```

输出目录须先创建。`--dry-run` 不生成 tarball；实际安装使用生成的 `.tgz`。保留每次候选包及其校验值，不覆盖已经用于验收或回退的包。

本版沿用以下完整组合，不接受交叉混装或未列出的补丁版本。DSH 主包中的 `~` 依赖不会因主包版本固定而自动锁定；以实际宿主解析结果为准。

| 组合 | Cordis | Loader | Include | Timer |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 保留基线 | `4.0.4` | `1.0.5` | `1.0.9` | `1.1.6` |
| 新补丁组合 | `4.0.5` | `1.0.6` | `1.0.10` | `1.1.7` |

已发布的 `0.1.0` 尚不包含新补丁组合与历史回执修复；它仍要求原 Cordis `4.0.4` 基线。插件仅从核验后的当前上下文读取历史回执对应的库存，不恢复旧安装引用或计划的写授权。

## 从 npm 安装

先查询 npm 上的精确版本，确认可用后安装。核对 DSH、Node 和上表完整 Cordis 组合，停止目标 Web Profile 的 Host，再执行插件安装；也可按下一节安装已验证的本地 tarball：

```sh
npm view @astron-team/skillhub-dsh@0.6.1 version
dsh plugin --profile skillhub-test add @astron-team/skillhub-dsh@0.6.1 --ignore-scripts
dsh --profile skillhub-test --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --no-open
```

`skillhub-test` 替换为实际 Web Profile；首次创建方法见下一节。未配置 `registryUrl` 时默认使用 `https://skill.xfyun.cn`。如需自建实例，在插件设置中修改来源并测试、保存；显式保存空地址可断开。npm 查询或下载失败与插件加载失败应分别诊断。

## 从旧版本升级

共享库存保持严格 v2，不写入 `installationState`；启停状态从可信的 `SKILL.md` / `SKILL.md.disabled` 入口派生，不要求 CLI 用户同步升级。已发布 CLI `0.2.0` 的正常查询和普通目标管理必须继续兼容；默认更新、同步及 Suite 不得无意重新启用停用目标。旧 CLI 显式 force 重装、更新、同步仍按原覆盖语义执行，可能恢复标准入口；显式 remove 仍可删除，新版重新读取须反映真实变化。

读取 v1/v2 不迁移。未发布构建产生的 v3 必须在身份、入口与未完成事务校验后，同锁保存原字节备份并安全转换为 v2；不能恢复过时备份覆盖新记录。旧 DSH 普通管理日志保持兼容，启停日志隔离影响。已通过真实旧包交替操作的兼容验收；公开可用状态以 npm 为准。

案例由作者随技能包提供固定文件 `.skillhub/examples.json`，安装后保持相同位置，跟随技能版本和指纹，不创建另一个全局案例副本。无案例时使用自定义任务；无效声明按普通文件保留，不提供错误的案例入口。

## 安装本地候选包

以下命令针对上述 DSH Web 发行版。`skillhub-test` 是示例 Profile 名称，请始终使用同一 Profile 和 DSH home 安装、启动和维护。首次测试应使用独立测试账户或容器、工作区和测试技能；仅创建 Profile 或更改 `DSH_HOME` 不能隔离共享技能 inventory。

新建 Web Profile，仅首次执行：

```sh
dsh --profile skillhub-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
```

停止使用该 Profile 的 Host，再安装本地包并启动：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile skillhub-test add /absolute/path/to/candidate.tgz --ignore-scripts
dsh --profile skillhub-test --host 127.0.0.1 --port 0 --no-open
```

打开 Host 输出的本机访问入口。入口可能含访问凭证，不要复制到报告、截图或提交中。示例绑定回环地址；远程访问需按环境既有访问控制部署，不直接公开 Host。

已有 Web Profile 不重复创建。`plugin add` 自动创建的基础 Profile 不等同于 Web Profile。若 `dsh` 不在 PATH，可用已安装发行版的 `node /absolute/path/to/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js` 替换命令中的 `dsh`。

Loader entry ID 为 `astron-skillhub`；`skillhub` 是 Host/Remote 服务名。手写配置 patch 必须定位正确包的 Loader ID，不能修改其他插件的同名入口。

## 配置技能来源

进入 DSH **Plugins/插件 → @astron-team/skillhub-dsh → SkillHub 设置**。

1. 在“技能来源”填写 **Registry 地址**，使用实例的 HTTP(S) 基础地址，可包含部署子路径；不要填写 API 路由、凭证、查询参数或片段。
2. 点击“测试连接”，使用当前草稿地址测试，不保存配置。结果显示公开目录可读或仅支持基础搜索及耗时；最长等待 10 秒，失败或超时可重试。修改地址后清除旧测试结果，连接成功不代表技能下载或所有可选接口可用。

## 使用流程

- **浏览技能**：搜索、服务端排序、真实标签筛选、点击加载更多。新目录接口每批 12 项；旧来源首批 404/405 可回退受限搜索，明确提示不支持分页和排序。选中标签失败不会退回未过滤结果。
- **技能详情**：查看文档、版本和可选模块；可“查看此版本”后确认安装指定的可下载版本。已有其他版本时保留覆盖保护，不执行降级。
- **已安装**：按技能聚合并支持关键词过滤。紧凑横向卡片在桌面显示两列、窄屏一列，点击卡片进入详情。可用技能保留“使用技能”主按钮，更多菜单提供“管理安装”和只检查当前技能各安装位置的“检查更新”，不自动执行更新。展示本地技能文件中的名称、一行摘要与实际安装版本；不同位置版本不同时明确标注多个版本。右上角最多显示安装异常/停用与更新状态两个标签（可更新为浅蓝、停用为灰、异常为琥珀色），正常已安装不重复标记。详情右侧按位置显示版本、状态和操作，升级、启停与卸载均只影响确认的位置。目录缺失时仍可清理失效记录。
- **对话搜索**：`astron_skillhub_search` 只搜索，不安装或执行技能。结果提供明确详情动作；详情抽屉可确认安装。
- **对话安装**：用户明确要求安装唯一搜索结果时，不必先打开详情。`astron_skillhub_install` 核验搜索时的精确版本和快照；接受 `selectionRef` 或完整坐标，二者互斥，范围为 `user`/`project`。过期或歧义引用拒绝执行，不改装当前 latest。

本地操作需要活动会话，Host 据此解析可信用户目录和工作区。远程 Host 的文件安装在 Host 所在机器，不在浏览器机器。插件不提供登录、评论提交或权限管理。

安装受理、文件完成、DSH 发现及模型实际使用是不同状态。安装卡主区展示结果，展开“安装记录”可查看核验、当前库存和原操作信息。历史完成不代表当前仍安装该版本，也不代表模型已执行。Host 重启后的历史搜索需要主动“重新查看详情”重新核验，不能恢复旧引用的写权限。

## 验证候选包

从 `plugins/dsh` 执行仓库提供的隔离 Host 冒烟脚本：

```sh
node scripts/smoke-native-host.mjs --artifact /absolute/path/to/candidate.tgz --report /absolute/path/to/host-smoke-summary.json --dsh-version 0.2.1-rc.2
```

脚本使用隔离 Web Profile 验证候选安装与 Host 加载；不调用模型，不替代 UI 或完整技能生命周期验收。浏览器和文件事务探针见源码中的 [集成验证指南](test/integration/README.md)。

对公开测试 Registry 执行匿名契约检查：

```sh
bun run probe:registry --registry 'https://registry.example' --namespace 'demo' --slug 'test-skill' --version '1.0.0' --output /absolute/path/to/registry-report.json
```

替换示例地址和精确版本，使用新的输出文件。脚本检查搜索、解析、元信息、说明、可选模块及归档指纹，归档仅在临时目录解包，不安装或执行技能。该探针不替代目录分页、标签、排序和真实 DSH 页面测试，后者须另外验收。必需项失败产生非零退出码；审核 HTTP 成功不等于公开审核 schema 已通过验证。

人工至少核验来源保存/重置、搜索和详情、用户/项目安装、更新及卸载、历史结果、深浅主题与窄屏、失败重试和来源变更保护。模型验收需单独确定模型配置和调用预算，不能以页面测试代替。

## 更新、回退与缓存

1. 停止提交新操作，等待已受理操作结束；待恢复事务先在原兼容环境处理。
2. 保存当前 tarball，停止使用该 Profile 的 Host。
3. 使用上面的 `plugin ... add` 命令安装目标 tarball，保持 Profile、来源、会话和模型配置不变。
4. 重新启动 Host，重新进入其有效访问入口；浏览器仍显示旧 UI 时进行强制刷新（Windows：Ctrl+Shift+R）。
5. 检查技能中心、配置、现有安装记录和历史查询，再执行测试技能操作。

强制刷新只更新浏览器资源，不会重载 Host 的 Node 模块。依赖变化必须完整重启 Host；禁用/启用插件不能代替依赖重载。官方 RC.2 的 Host 同端口重启可能使原标签页空白，不能承诺无缝重连；保留原操作记录，用有效入口重新进入，不重复提交安装。

回退使用已保留、已验证兼容的 tarball，按相同步骤执行。开发候选替换验证不构成跨正式版本日志兼容承诺。未知日志格式、待恢复事务不能通过删除日志或重装包绕过。插件回退与技能版本降级不是同一功能。

临时停用可在 DSH 插件页关闭本包开关；启用后等待“技能中心”恢复。移除包使用：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile skillhub-test remove @astron-team/skillhub-dsh
```

`remove` 不接受 `--ignore-scripts`。禁用或移除插件不等于卸载技能，不删除技能目录、inventory 或操作日志。操作结果未知时查询原请求；需要恢复时使用界面的“核验并恢复”，不要发起新请求替代恢复。

## 服务端同步与发布

插件 Host 调用匿名 Registry HTTP API；本地安装事务在 Host 内完成，不需要 SaaS 新增操作用户文件系统的安装接口。开源先定义和验证契约，再将缺失的路径、字段、匿名策略和测试同步到 SaaS。公开 npm `0.2.0` 已对 `https://skill.xfyun.cn` 完成目录、搜索、文档、版本选择和固定版本项目安装及文件/指纹、库存、DSH 发现核验；各版本的构建产物与公开包分别验收。日期格式等无法可靠排序的非 SemVer 版本继续阻断自动升级，不显示可执行升级入口；这不影响已验证的固定版本首次安装。SaaS 技能的真实模型执行尚未验收。详细要求见 [Registry 契约](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/registry-api-contract.md)。

插件独立使用 `dsh-v<version>` tag，不复用 CLI 或服务镜像发布。`check-dsh-plugin.yml` 配置 Linux/macOS/Windows × Node 24.2.0/当前 Node 24 的普通干净安装检查，并额外保留旧 Cordis 组合的隔离 Host 回归；`release-dsh-plugin.yml` 手动触发，默认只产出候选包。发布需正式版本、可发布 manifest、候选验收及明确发布授权；配置了环境保护规则时还须完成相应审批。版本更新需显式提交，npm 发布需明确授权后运行专用工作流。

具体部署、发布后检查与回退清单见 [发布指南](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/release-guide.md)，变化见 [发布说明](../../openspec/changes/add-dsh-native-plugin/release-notes.md)。上述 OpenSpec 与测试链接面向源码仓库，不包含在 npm tarball 中。

### 市场交互与安装管理

市场卡片支持点击进入详情及独立安装、卸载、检查更新/升级操作；多范围记录先选择管理目标。用户明确要求安装后，未指定范围默认当前用户；明确指定当前项目时安装到项目。市场卡片的安装按钮也直接打开确认弹窗；默认预选当前用户，项目级位于高级选项，但不自动提交。用户后续明确范围也可发起新调用。详情隐藏完整首部元数据，保留安全 Markdown；公开读取缓存 60 秒，写入仍重新核验。版本 Tab 请求 `downloadableOnly=true`，需要本次开源后端契约；SaaS 尚需单独同步和验收。

安装管理以当前库存为准，历史成功不代表仍已安装。“仅此项目”对应项目目录，“所有项目”对应当前 Host 的用户级目录。二级管理中的“安装其他位置”会重新打开安装确认；选择范围不会自动安装。

SkillHub is a self-hosted platform that gives teams a private,
governed place to share agent skills. Publish a skill package, push
it to a namespace, and let others find it through search or
install it via CLI. Built for on-premise deployment behind your
firewall, with the same polish you'd expect from a public registry.

> ⭐ If SkillHub fits your team, **star** the repo to help other teams find it, and **Watch → Custom → Releases** to get notified when a new version ships.

## Share Great Skills

Great Skills become more valuable when they are shared. If you have a Skill that has
proved useful in real work or everyday life, share it with the SkillHub community and
help grow an open, practical Skill ecosystem. We welcome Skills for daily life, office
work, learning and research, travel and events, content creation, data analysis, and
software development—not only engineering workflows.

High-quality community contributions may join the curated starter collection, making new
SkillHub deployments useful from day one. You do not need to finish the full adaptation
before joining in: [open an issue](https://github.com/iflytek/skillhub/issues/new/choose)
with the Skill's source and the problem it solves, or submit a PR by following the
[Skill sharing guide](./builtin-skills/README.md).

## Highlights

- **Self-Hosted & Private** — Deploy on your own infrastructure.
  Keep proprietary skills behind your firewall with full data
  sovereignty. One `make dev-all` command to get running locally.
- **Publish & Version** — Upload agent skill packages with semantic
  versioning, custom tags (`beta`, `stable`), and automatic
  `latest` tracking.
- **Discover** — Full-text search with filters by namespace,
  downloads, ratings, and recency. Visibility rules ensure
  users only see what they're authorized to.
- **Team Namespaces** — Organize skills under team or global scopes.
  Each namespace has its own members, roles (Owner / Admin /
  Member), and publishing policies.
- **Review & Governance** — Team admins review within their namespace;
  platform admins gate promotions to the global scope. Governance
  actions are audit-logged for compliance.
- **Social Features** — Star skills, rate them, and track downloads.
  Build a community around your organization's best practices.
- **Account Merging** — Consolidate multiple OAuth identities and
  API tokens under a single user account.
- **API Token Management** — Generate scoped tokens for CLI and
  programmatic access with prefix-based secure hashing.
- **CLI-First** — Native REST API plus a compatibility layer for
  existing ClawHub-style registry clients. Native CLI APIs are the
  primary supported path while protocol compatibility continues to
  expand.
- **Pluggable Storage** — Local filesystem for development, S3 /
  MinIO for production. Swap via config.
- **Internationalization** — Multi-language support with i18next: English, Simplified Chinese, Russian, and Korean.

## Quick Start

To host your own registry using release images, start with:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up
```

The default command pulls the `latest` stable release images. Use `--version edge` if you want the newest build from `main`.

**Configure public URL (recommended for production):**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com
```

The `--public-url` parameter sets the public access URL for your SkillHub instance. This ensures:
- CLI install commands show the correct registry URL
- Agent setup instructions display the correct skill.md URL
- OAuth callbacks and device auth links work properly

**For users in China (Aliyun mirror):**

```bash
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --aliyun --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com --version latest
```

Keep the existing runtime home when rerunning or updating the deployment. The
runtime script reuses its `.env.release` file; deleting the directory discards
your custom configuration, including the public URL and generated anonymous
download cookie secret.

If deployment runs into problems, inspect the `ps` and `logs` lifecycle commands
printed by the runtime script, then retry `up` with the same runtime home. If you
intentionally want a fresh configuration, back up `.env.release` before clearing
the runtime home.

### Container Runtime

Published runtime images are built by GitHub Actions and pushed to GHCR.
This is the supported path for anyone who wants a ready-to-use local
environment without building the backend or frontend on their machine.
Published server and web images target `linux/amd64`, `linux/arm64`, and
`linux/riscv64`; the scanner image currently targets `linux/amd64` and
`linux/arm64`.

**Quick deployment with curl:**

```bash
# Default (GHCR images)
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com

# Aliyun mirror (recommended for users in China)
curl -fsSL https://imageless.oss-cn-beijing.aliyuncs.com/runtime.sh | sh -s -- up --aliyun --public-url https://skillhub.your-company.com --version latest

```

**Deployment parameters:**

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `--public-url <url>` | Public access URL (recommended) | `--public-url https://skill.example.com` |
| `--version <tag>` | Specific image tag | `--version v0.2.0` |
| `--aliyun` | Use Aliyun mirror (China) | `--aliyun` |
| `--home <dir>` | Runtime directory | `--home /opt/skillhub` |
| `--no-scanner` | Disable security scanner | `--no-scanner` |

> **Important**: Configure `--public-url` for production deployments to ensure CLI install commands and Agent setup instructions display the correct URLs.

For sub-path deployments, keep the public URL and runtime base path aligned in
`.env.release`: set `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL=https://skill.example.com/skillhub`,
`SKILLHUB_WEB_BASE_PATH=/skillhub/`, and `SKILLHUB_WEB_API_BASE_URL=/skillhub`.

**Manual deployment:**

1. Copy the runtime environment template.
2. Pick an image tag.
3. Start the stack with Docker Compose.

```bash
cp .env.release.example .env.release
```

Recommended image tags:

- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=latest` for the latest stable release (default)
- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=edge` for the latest `main` build
- `SKILLHUB_VERSION=vX.Y.Z` for a fixed release

Start the runtime:

```bash
make validate-release-config
docker compose --env-file .env.release -f compose.release.yml up -d
```

Then open:

- Web UI: `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` 对应的地址
- Backend API: `http://localhost:8080`

Stop it with:

```bash
docker compose --env-file .env.release -f compose.release.yml down
```

The runtime stack uses its own Compose project name, so it does not
collide with containers from `make dev-all`.

The production Compose stack now defaults to the `docker` profile only.
It does not enable local mock auth. The release template (`.env.release.example`)
enables the bootstrap admin by default, so zero-config quickstart via
`runtime.sh` works out of the box:

- username: `admin`
- password: `ChangeMe!2026`

Recommended production baseline:

- set `SKILLHUB_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` to the final HTTPS entrypoint
- if the service is published under a sub-path such as `/skillhub/`, set
  `SKILLHUB_WEB_BASE_PATH=/skillhub/` and `SKILLHUB_WEB_API_BASE_URL=/skillhub`
  as well
- keep PostgreSQL / Redis bound to `127.0.0.1`
- use external S3 / OSS via `SKILLHUB_STORAGE_S3_*`
- change `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD` to a strong password (`validate-release-config.sh` rejects the default `ChangeMe!2026`)
- rotate or disable the bootstrap admin after initial setup
- run `make validate-release-config` before `docker compose up -d`

If the GHCR package remains private, run `docker login ghcr.io` before

Skill package upload validation uses the default extension allowlist from
[`SkillPackagePolicy.java`](./server/skillhub-domain/src/main/java/com/iflytek/skillhub/domain/skill/validation/SkillPackagePolicy.java).
`SkillPublishProperties` uses that same list by default for
`skillhub.publish.allowed-file-extensions`.

If you need to replace the default allowlist at runtime, set:

```bash
SKILLHUB_PUBLISH_ALLOWED_FILE_EXTENSIONS=.md,.json,.xsd,.xsl,.dtd,.docx,.xlsx,.pptx
```

Spring Boot binds this environment variable to
`skillhub.publish.allowed-file-extensions`. When set, it replaces the default
allowlist instead of appending to it.

### Monitoring

The optional [`monitoring/`](./monitoring) directory provides Prometheus and Grafana deployment examples. It is not a ready-to-scrape backend configuration: the default application exposes only `health` and `info` Actuator endpoints. `/actuator/prometheus` also requires the `SUPER_ADMIN` or `AUDITOR` role under the current route policy, while the example scraper has no credentials configured.

Before enabling monitoring, configure metrics exposure and an authenticated access path appropriate to your deployment; verify that the scraper can actually read the endpoint. Do not make management endpoints public merely to satisfy the example. The example targets `host.docker.internal:8080`, which must resolve to your backend from the Prometheus container.

After adapting that configuration, start the optional stack:

```bash
cd monitoring
docker compose -f docker-compose.monitoring.yml up -d
```

Prometheus uses port `9090` and Grafana uses port `3001`. Replace the example Grafana administrator credentials before exposing it. Confirm scrape targets are healthy and metrics are present; starting the containers alone does not establish monitoring coverage. For tracing and request correlation, see the [observability developer guide](docs/observability-developer-guide.md).

## SkillHub and the Agent Skills Ecosystem

SkillHub is a **registry and governance platform** — not a skill collection.
It is complementary to open skill catalogs such as
[`anthropics/skills`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills): that repository
popularized the **Agent Skill format** (a `SKILL.md` with `name` / `description`
frontmatter plus supporting files) and ships a curated set of example skills.
SkillHub is where your organization **hosts, versions, governs, and distributes**
those skills privately.

|  | [`anthropics/skills`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills) | **SkillHub** |
|---|---|---|
| What it is | A curated collection of example Agent Skills + the format spec | A self-hosted registry & governance platform for skills |
| Layer | Content — the skills themselves | Infrastructure — hosting, versioning, discovery, access control |
| Hosting | Public GitHub repository | Your own infrastructure, behind your firewall |
| Versioning | Git history | Semantic versions, tags (`beta` / `stable`), `latest` tracking |
| Access control | Public | Namespaces, RBAC, review & audit logging |
| Distribution | Clone / copy files | Full-text search + CLI install |

Because SkillHub speaks the same `SKILL.md` format, skills from `anthropics/skills`
— or any Agent Skill folder — publish straight into your registry:

```bash
# Grab a skill from an open collection...
git clone https://github.com/anthropics/skills

# ...and publish it into your private SkillHub registry
export SKILLHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com
export SKILLHUB_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN
npx @astron-team/skillhub@latest publish ./skills/<category>/<skill-name>
```

> ⚖️ **Licensing**: honor each skill's own license when republishing. Most skills in
> `anthropics/skills` are Apache 2.0, but the document skills (DOCX/PDF/PPTX/XLSX) are
> source-available rather than open source — check the skill's `LICENSE` before redistributing.

**In short: use collections like `anthropics/skills` for content, and SkillHub to
distribute it across your organization under governance.**

SkillHub works as a skill registry backend for several agent platforms. Point any of the clients below at your SkillHub instance to publish, discover, and install skills.

### [OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw)

[OpenClaw](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw) is an open-source agent skill CLI. Configure it to use your SkillHub endpoint as the registry:

```bash
# Configure registry URL
export CLAWHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com

# Authenticate once if needed
clawhub login --token YOUR_API_TOKEN

# Search and install skills
npx clawhub search email
npx clawhub install my-skill
npx clawhub install my-namespace--my-skill

# Publishing uses the first-party SkillHub CLI
export SKILLHUB_REGISTRY=https://skillhub.your-company.com
export SKILLHUB_TOKEN=YOUR_API_TOKEN
npx @astron-team/skillhub@latest publish ./my-skill --namespace my-space
```

`my-space--my-skill` is the canonical compat slug. SkillHub parses it as
namespace `my-space` plus skill slug `my-skill`.

ClawHub compatibility covers search, inspection, and installation. Its publish
protocol is not compatible with SkillHub; use the first-party CLI shown above.

> 💡 **Tip**: The above commands are not only applicable to OpenClaw, but also to other CLI Coding Agents or Agent assistants by specifying the installation directory (`--dir`). For example: `npx clawhub --dir ~/.claude/skills install my-skill`

📖 **[Complete OpenClaw Integration Guide →](./docs/openclaw-integration.md)**

### [Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent)

[Hermes Agent](https://github.com/NousResearch/hermes-agent) uses the standard `SKILL.md` format and recursively discovers skills under `$HERMES_HOME/skills/`. Use SkillHub CLI's explicit `--dir` option to install a complete SkillHub package into Hermes without a registry adapter, then verify it with `hermes skills list`.

📖 **[Complete Hermes Agent Integration Guide →](./docs/hermes-integration-en.md)**

### [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) discovers standard `SKILL.md` packages from `.dsh/skills` and the shared `.agents/skills` roots. Install directly into its native user directory with the first-party SkillHub CLI:

```bash
skillhub install my-skill --agent dsh --scope user
```

Project-scoped installs use `<repository>/.dsh/skills`; run them from the repository root. dsh watches its skill roots, so newly installed skills are discovered without restarting the process.

📖 **[Complete DeepSeek Harness Integration Guide →](./docs/dsh-integration-en.md)**

### [HarnessClaw Engine](https://github.com/harnessclaw/harnessclaw-engine)

[HarnessClaw Engine](https://github.com/harnessclaw/harnessclaw-engine) is a Go LLM programming assistant engine that exposes its capabilities over WebSocket. It loads skills from `SKILL.md` files with YAML frontmatter and parameter substitution, scanning each configured directory for `skill-name/SKILL.md` (default `~/.harnessclaw/workspace/skills/`, with earlier directories taking priority on name conflicts). Install a SkillHub package straight into that directory with the CLI's `--dir` option, no registry adapter required:

```bash
npx clawhub --dir ~/.harnessclaw/workspace/skills install my-skill
```
### [AstronClaw](https://agent.xfyun.cn/astron-claw)

[AstronClaw](https://agent.xfyun.cn/astron-claw) is a cloud AI assistant built on OpenClaw's core capabilities, providing 24/7 online service through enterprise platforms like WeChat Work, DingTalk, and Feishu. It features a built-in skill system with over 130 official skills. You can connect it to a self-hosted SkillHub registry to enable one-click skill installation, search repository, dialogue-based automatic installation, and even custom skills management within your organization.

### [Loomy](https://loomy.xunfei.cn/)

[Loomy](https://loomy.xunfei.cn/) is a desktop AI work partner focusing on real office scenarios. It integrates deeply with local files and system tools to build efficient automated workflows for individuals and small teams. By connecting Loomy to your SkillHub registry, you can easily discover and install organization-specific skills to enhance your local desktop automation and productivity.

### [astron-agent](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent)

[astron-agent](https://github.com/iflytek/astron-agent) is the iFlytek Astron agent framework. Skills stored in SkillHub can be referenced and loaded by astron-agent, enabling a governed, versioned skill lifecycle from development to production.

import { assertHostDependencies, cordisFamilies, hostDependencyBaseline, supportedDshVersions, type SupportedDshVersion } from './compatibility.js';

/** Candidate runtime range, validated at its lower bound and current Node 24 release. */
export const nodeRuntimeRange = '>=24.2.0 <25';

export function assertNodeRuntime(version = process.versions.node): void {
  const match = /^(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)\.(0|[1-9]\d*)$/.exec(version);
  if (!match || Number(match[1]) !== 24 || Number(match[2]) < 2) {
    throw new Error('Node runtime baseline does not match; local writes are disabled.');
  }
}

export const runtimePackageBaseline = {
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh': '0.2.0-rc.2',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot': '0.2.0-rc.2',
  ...hostDependencyBaseline,
  '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader': '1.0.5',
  '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-include': '1.0.9',
  '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer': '1.1.6',
};

export const clientPackageBaseline = [
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-gateway',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plugin-manager',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-tool',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-session-controller',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-session',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-workspace-controller',
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace',
] as const;

interface RuntimeServices {
  packageOf(name: string, parentURL: string): { name: string; version?: string; manifestPath?: string } | undefined;
  clientPath(name: string): string | undefined;
}

function clientManifest(file: string, name: string): unknown {
  let directory = dirname(file);
  while (directory) {
    try {
      const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(join(directory, 'package.json'), 'utf8'));
      if (manifest.name === name) return manifest;
    } catch (error) {
      if (!(error && typeof error === 'object' && 'code' in error && error.code === 'ENOENT')) throw error;
    }
    const parent = dirname(directory);
    if (parent === directory) break;
    directory = parent;
  }
  throw new Error('Client owning manifest unavailable');
}

/** Read the current Host resolution and Client graph on each new write; never cache acceptance. */
export function assertRuntimeCompatibility(
  services: RuntimeServices,
  parentURL: string,
  readClientManifest: (file: string, name: string) => unknown = clientManifest,
  readHostManifest: (file: string) => unknown = file => JSON.parse(readFileSync(file, 'utf8')),
): SupportedDshVersion {
  try {
    assertNodeRuntime();
    const readPackage = (name: string, parent: string) => {
      const actual = services.packageOf(name, parent);
      if (actual?.name !== name || !actual.manifestPath) throw new Error('Runtime package mismatch');
      // packageOf caches metadata until a resolution generation is replaced.
      const current = readHostManifest(actual.manifestPath);
      if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || !('name' in current) || !('version' in current)
        || current.name !== name || current.version !== actual.version) throw new Error('Runtime manifest mismatch');
      return actual;
    };
    const packages = new Map(Object.keys(runtimePackageBaseline).map(name => [name, readPackage(name, parentURL)]));
    const family = cordisFamilies.find(candidate => Object.entries(candidate).every(([name, version]) => packages.get(name)?.version === version));
    const release = packages.get('@deepseek-ai/dsh')?.version;
    if (!supportedDshVersions.some(version => version === release)) throw new Error('Unsupported DSH release');
    if (!family || (release === '0.2.1-rc.2' && family['@deepseek-ai/cordis'] !== '4.0.5')) throw new Error('Runtime Cordis family mismatch');
    for (const [name, version] of Object.entries({ ...runtimePackageBaseline, ...family })) {
      const expected = name.startsWith('@deepseek-ai/dsh') ? release : version;
      if (packages.get(name)?.version !== expected) throw new Error('Runtime package mismatch');
    }
    // Check the Host's own dependency lookup, not just the plugin's peer copies.
    // A nested peer can otherwise hide an unsupported Host dependency graph.
    for (const anchor of ['@deepseek-ai/dsh', '@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot']) {
      const anchorURL = pathToFileURL(packages.get(anchor)!.manifestPath!).href;
      for (const [name, expected] of packages) {
        if (readPackage(name, anchorURL).version !== expected.version) throw new Error('Host dependency graph mismatch');
      }
    }
    assertHostDependencies(name => packages.get(name));
    for (const name of clientPackageBaseline) {
      const file = services.clientPath(name);
      if (!file) throw new Error('Client module unavailable');
      const manifest = readClientManifest(file, name);
      if (!manifest || typeof manifest !== 'object' || !('name' in manifest) || !('version' in manifest)
        || manifest.name !== name || manifest.version !== release) throw new Error('Client package mismatch');
    }
    return release as SupportedDshVersion;
  } catch {
    throw new Error('Host runtime baseline could not be verified; local writes are disabled.');
  }
}
